title: data/seed/<poolId>/demo.json (demo identities and plans, written by the simulation)

featuredPlanIds.description: Pinned, in order, into Maya's first feed when DEMO_MODE=1. Includes heroPlanId and nudgePlanId.

heroPlanId.description: The plan Maya joins on stage: prepaid (shows the payment approval), matches her top interests, fits her fallback availability, travel under her max.

nudgePlanId.description: Plan that never needs a payment approval (free or pay at venue) at the venue of Maya's frequent-place record; drives the Home nudge.

liveUserId.description: Identity the second phone uses. Public profile, shares at least two of Maya's top interests, not yet joined to heroPlanId.

counterpartIds.description: Personas the synthetic actor drives. Includes liveUserId, at least one private profile, and enough people to form heroPlanId with Maya (size.min - 1 or more).

privateCounterpartId.description: A private-profile counterpart that ends up in Maya's hero group (shows first-name-only reveal).

fakeLocation.description: Maya's demo check-in location fallback, inside her neighborhood.
